propositions: Quickstart examples in README.md and docs/user-guide.md teach bare handle values (alice, bob) for --assignee which are Jira-unresolvable and get silently cleared on reconcile, contradicting the documented requirement in docs/config.md that assignees be Jira-resolvable identities.

Documentation routing and configuration descriptions are outdated: docs/README.md routes MCP navigation to llm-framework.md instead of mcp-reference.md, and describes config.md as covering the removed .rebar/config.conf flat keys rather than rebar.toml or [tool.rebar] pyproject table.

pyproject.toml comment states non-core tree mypy checking is advisory-only, but CI gates (Makefile and _build-and-test.yml) actually enforce mypy over the whole library and scripts, creating a documentation-to-reality mismatch.
Corrections require no behavior changes or generator re-runs, only updates to doc examples, links, and comments, verified by grep assertions and existing CI test gates.
